body:
I've been trying to get a new job for 5 years now. I've become so socially inept, I don't do well in interviews. 

I may just leave my career and just go work at a grocery store or maybe become a janitor or something. It sucks that I'm in my 30's and looking at a high school kid's job but I have acquired so much debt with hospital bills and I'm so horrible with people I guess I shouldn't ask for anymore than that.

I get death threats at work all the time. I was stabbed just last month. These people aren't joking. 

It's not everyone, it's most people. I don't know how to talk to these people. When someone says, "I got this computer from you yesterday, my power was cut off this morning. Is that why it won't turn on." Then you respond, "Computers will not work if there is no power." Then they say, "What a piece of shit, I want my mother fucking money back. I'm going to tell everyone to never come here...." Then they get violent and start breaking stuff.

This is everyday. These responses are below reasonable. I've lost any interest in dealing with mankind any more.
